{{Quote|We're colonists. This is an unclaimed system. There's no law here.|Arratan to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''Arratan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] chief who based his gang on [[Blood Nest]], the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Blood Nest|M2398-3]] on the [[M2398 system]].<ref name="WS" />

When the modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] arrived to negotiate with them, the Blood Nest pirates attacked the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] aligned [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. They were not aware that [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron, was secretly in command of the ship. After a short [[Battle of M2398-3|battle]], during which Arratan's forces were quickly destroyed by the Wraith's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].<ref name="WS" />

The pirates surrendered and Arratan was questioned by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]; who was furious at the loss of one of his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] communications expert [[Jesmin Ackbar]], at the hands of Arratun's forces. Threatening to have the entire lot of pirates thrown into the inhospitable wastes of the moon, Antilles spared the man's life only in exchange for everything he knew about Zsinj's operations in the area.<ref name="WS" />
